low.title: Payment wording differs slightly from the MSA
low.quote: AtliQ shall invoice each Milestone Fee on acceptance of the relevant Milestone. The Client shall pay within thirty (30) days of receipt of invoice, as per the MSA.
low.note: The MSA says invoice on completion of a milestone and payment within 30 days of the invoice date; the SOW says on acceptance and 30 days of receipt, and calls it 'as per the MSA'. Still 30 days, but the clock can start a little later.

low.title: Acceptance window shorter than the MSA, and the MSA says it prevails unless the SOW expressly overrides it
low.quote: The Client shall review each Deliverable within seven (7) working days of delivery and either confirm acceptance or share a consolidated list of defects against the agreed requirements.
low.note: The MSA gives Sunrise 10 Business Days. The shorter 7 working days favours AtliQ if it applies, but SOW §2.2 lets the MSA prevail unless the SOW 'expressly states otherwise', and §6 does not say it overrides the MSA. 'Working days' is not defined in the SOW.

low.title: Delay credit is new compared with the MSA, and headed 'Penalty for Delay'
low.quote: 8.4 Service credits shall be adjusted against the next invoice and shall be the Client's sole remedy for delay.
low.note: The MSA has no delay credit at all, only support service credits, and says its credits 'are not a penalty'. The SOW heading uses the word 'Penalty' while the text is a capped service credit; maximum USD 2,250 across the SOW.

low.title: Only Sunrise can end an SOW for convenience (inherited from the MSA)
low.quote: Sunrise may terminate any SOW for convenience by giving forty-five (45) days' written notice, subject to payment for all work performed up to the effective date of termination.
low.note: AtliQ has no matching right. Payment for all work performed protects AtliQ, and this was signed in the MSA in April 2025; SOW-2 does not change it.

low.title: No support or maintenance period in SOW-2
low.quote: together with post-go-live support and maintenance for twelve (12) months.
low.note: SOW-1 included 12 months of support; SOW-2 prices four build milestones only and mentions just the MSA warranty period. Worth asking Dhaval whether Sunrise expects support for v2.
